source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed electrical appliance safety checks

1. Start with the test records.
2.
completion:
Find the record of the device in the failed test results.
3. Record the asset ID of the device in the appropriate failure report type.
4. Record the details of the appliance failure (including the relevant fail code) in the notes/comments area.

# The following document contains two samples of completed failure forms.

# Visual Inspections

* If a device does not pass the visual inspection, record the failure reason in the notes/comments area of the appropriate failure report type.

# Combined Inspection and Test

* Follow the Pass and No Test Types instructions on the front of the asset record page.
* Record the relevant PAT Class and Fail reason in the appropriate failure report type.
* Record the test details in the notes/comments area of the appropriate failure report type.

# Combined Inspection and Test - Earth Continuity Pass

* Ensure the appliance ID is recorded in the appropriate failure report type.
* Record Insulation Resistance Fail
